manifest.name: dsh-a2a-server
manifest.description: Inbound A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol server for DeepSeek Harness: publish an Agent Card and let any A2A-compliant peer submit tasks to a harness agent

scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:package

bundle.text:
# The layer this bundle contributes when a profile lists it.
#
# `isolation.workspaceRoot` has no safe default and must be supplied, and an
# empty `peers` table means every request is answered 401 — both deliberate, so
# an unconfigured install exposes nothing.
#
# REQUIRES ctx.webServer, which ships in `dsh-web-app`, NOT in `dsh-base`. On a
# profile without it this row loads but stays PENDING (Cordis holds a plugin
# whose injected services are absent), so nothing serves and nothing errors.
#
# NOTE: keep this file plain YAML — the installer's package validation parses
# it with a strict loader that rejects `!!js` expressions, even though the
# runtime overlay loader accepts them.
- insert:
    - id: a2a-server
      name: dsh-a2a-server
      config:
        basePath: /a2a
        card:
          name: dsh-harness
          description: A DeepSeek Harness agent reachable over A2A.
          public: true
          skills: []
        peers: {}
        isolation:
          # Each peer gets its own working directory. This is not a filesystem
          # sandbox: read_file separately restricts reads to the selected root,
          # or to a peerWorkspaces override. Other visitor tools are disabled.
          # This placeholder is overridden by any real deployment layer (the
          # console's overlay sets it per agent); supply an absolute path.
          workspaceMode: per-peer
          workspaceRoot: /srv/dsh/a2a
        push:
          enabled: false

readme.text:
dsh-a2a-server

Inbound A2A protocol server for DeepSeek Harness.
Publish an Agent Card, accept tasks from any compliant peer.
Everything is a plugin — this is one.

English · 简体中文
A community plugin, not an official DeepSeek product.

`dsh-a2a-server` makes a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
agent reachable over the [A2A (Agent2Agent)](https://a2a-protocol.org) protocol. It
serves an Agent Card at a well-known URI and implements the **v1.0 JSON-RPC
binding**, so any compliant peer that knows the deployment's URL can discover the
agent and submit tasks to it.

The plugin is **inbound only**: it never connects to another agent. There is no
client, no peer directory, and no A2A subagent provider. It is a transport
adapter over `ctx.agents`, not a capability seam.

For a local configuration UI and cross-network access, use the companion
[Talk2MyAgent setup guide](https://github.com/huangjuhua-aigc/Talk2MyAgent/blob/main/README.en.md).
See the [deployment and migration guide](https://github.com/huangjuhua-aigc/dsh-a2a/blob/main/docs/public-access-hardening.en.md)
for visitor permissions, automatic briefings, private owner access and Tailscale.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-a2a-server@0.4.1
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory and appends this
bundle to `dsh.profile.bundles`, because the package declares `dsh.bundle`.
Since DSH v0.2.1-alpha.1, `--profile` must come before any pnpm arguments —
the forms above already do.

To work from a checkout instead, point it at the directory:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./path/to/dsh-a2a-server
```

| Requirement | Supplied by |
| --- | --- |
| `ctx.agents` | `dsh-base` |
| `ctx.credentials` | `dsh-base` |
| `ctx.webServer` | **`dsh-web-app`** |
| `ctx.tools` and `ctx.systemPrompt` | required visitor tool and prompt isolation services |
| `ctx.sessionProjections` (optional) | composition; exposes task lifecycle projections |

The plugin stays PENDING until all required services exist. `ctx.webServer`
ships in `dsh-web-app` rather than `dsh-base`, so a `headless` profile needs
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver` mounted before this bundle serves anything.
`dsh --profile <name> --dump-config` prints the composed rows.

Version 0.4.1 requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`. Stop the agent, install
`dsh-a2a-server@0.4.1` into its existing profile, then restart it. Owner RPC and
monitoring now use authenticated local IPC; update the companion Portal as well.
Visitors retain chat and scoped workspace reads, while other tools are denied.
An empty `trustedPeers: []` denies all visitors. Task results persist across
restart within the configured retention window.

The current [Talk2MyAgent Portal](https://github.com/huangjuhua-aigc/Talk2MyAgent)
configures default-on hourly briefings with one persistent switch. The plugin
alone does not enable automatic briefing without its `briefing` configuration.
Portal automatically prepares Microsandbox for per-visitor isolation. Public data is copied read-only, excluding `node_modules`; private files persist on independent visitor disks. Idle VMs pause after 30 seconds and stop after 10 minutes. Existing standalone configurations keep their selected execution mode; installing the plugin alone does not enable a VM. See the [sandbox guide](docs/visitor-isolation.en.md) and [0.4.1 release notes](https://github.com/huangjuhua-aigc/dsh-a2a/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

The companion Portal can opt into public access, off by default. Clients send normally; an explicit pre-execution 401 challenge lets the updated skill register, save a server-issued credential and continue the original message once. The local server enforces five accepted messages across conversations and restarts, then asks the visitor to contact the owner for access. This is an optional RPC extension, not a redirect or automatic behavior of every A2A client. See the [client flow, quota rules and credential storage](docs/public-visitors.en.md). Existing invited peers retain their access; when public admission is enabled, its issued identities are admitted independently of `trustedPeers`.

The bundled example composition runs a real model and a listening server.

```sh
pnpm install
A2A_PEERS="alice:demo123" A2A_PORT=9922 pnpm serve
```

```powershell
$env:A2A_PEERS = "alice:demo123"
$env:A2A_PORT = "9922"
pnpm serve
```

Peer names are arbitrary — `alice` is this demo's default, not a protocol
fixture. Name as many as you like, and either carry the token inline or store it
under the derived credential reference:

```sh
A2A_PEERS="ops:tok1,research:tok2"   # inline
A2A_PEERS="ops,research"             # tokens from A2A_PEER_OPS / A2A_PEER_RESEARCH
```

The model credential is resolved through `ctx.credentials`, so an existing
`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` in the harness home, either `.env` layer, or the process
environment is picked up unchanged. A missing credential fails the boot.

Fetch the card and submit a task:

```sh
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9922/.well-known/agent-card.json

curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9922/a2a \
  -H "authorization: Bearer demo123" \

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `A2A_PEERS` | `alice` | `name[:token]` list; a token is required for each |
| `A2A_PORT` | `9900` | Listening port |
| `A2A_SEND_MODE` | `block` | `block` or `immediate` |
| `A2A_WORKSPACE_ROOT` | temp dir | Shared public data; visitor workspaces live outside this root |
| `DEEPSEEK_MODEL` | `deepseek-v4-flash` | Model id requested from the adapter |

A one-shot probe runs 67 checks against a live server and exits non-zero on any
mismatch:

```sh
pnpm probe                                        # defaults to :9922 / demo123
node example/probe.mjs http://127.0.0.1:9922 demo123
```

| Route | Method | Auth |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/.well-known/agent-card.json` | GET | Public by default |
| `/.well-known/agent.json` | GET | Public by default |
| `{basePath}` (default `/a2a`) | POST | Bearer required |
| `{basePath}/admin/contexts[/<id>]` | GET | Local IPC only + admin token; never registered on public HTTP |
| `{basePath}/admin/prepare-stop` | POST | Local IPC + admin token; drain tasks and stop sandboxes before terminating DSH |

| JSON-RPC method | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `SendMessage` | Waiting negotiated per request |
| `SendStreamingMessage` | SSE |
| `GetTask` | Idempotent; answers after settlement |
| `ListTasks` | Cursor-paginated, filterable, live and retained tasks |
| `CancelTask` | Cancels the running turn |
| `SubscribeToTask` | Live stream; `-32004` on a terminal task |
| `GetExtendedAgentCard` | Extra skills for an authenticated peer; `-32007` when unconfigured |
| `*TaskPushNotificationConfig` | `-32003` |

**Only A2A v1.0 is served.** The v0.3 method names, `kind` discriminators,
lowercase enums, and nested `file` parts are gone rather than aliased: every
reply this server writes is v1.0 JSON, which a v0.3 client could not read, so
answering a v0.3 request would fail further from its cause than refusing it. A
retired method answers `-32601` naming its replacement, and an explicit
`A2A-Version: 0.3` answers `-32009` (`VersionNotSupportedError`). A request with
no `A2A-Version` header is served as 1.0 — the only version this interface
declares on its card.

| Concern | v0.3 | v1.0 as served here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Task reference | `params.taskId` | `params.id` |
| `SendMessage` result | bare `Task` | `{ "task": … }` |
| Task state | `"working"` | `"TASK_STATE_WORKING"` |
| Message role | `"user"` | `"ROLE_USER"` |
| Part | `{"kind":"text","text":…}` | `{"text":…}`; file parts flatten to `url`/`raw`/`filename`/`mediaType` |
| Stream frame | `{"kind":"status-update",…,"final":true}` | `{"statusUpdate":{…}}`; the stream's close is the terminal signal |
| Stream opening | a non-final status update | the `Task` object itself |
| Wait control | `configuration.blocking` | `configuration.returnImmediately` (inverted; blocking is the default) |
| Card endpoint | `url` + `preferredTransport` | `supportedInterfaces[]`, each carrying its own `protocolVersion` |
| Card auth | `securitySchemes` + `security` | schemes wrapped in `httpAuthSecurityScheme`; `securityRequirements` |
| Extended card | `supportsAuthenticatedExtendedCard` | `capabilities.extendedAgentCard` |
| A2A error detail | none | `error.data[]` carrying a `google.rpc.ErrorInfo` with `reason` and `domain` |

Inbound messages may carry text, file, and data parts. File and data parts are
rendered into the model's context as bracketed references. Replies are text.

Authentication, rate limiting, and the trust gate answer with HTTP `401`, `429`,
and `403`; the body remains a valid JSON-RPC error envelope. A task belonging to
another peer answers exactly as an absent one.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `basePath` | `/a2a` | JSON-RPC route |
| `publicUrl` | derived from `Host` | Routable URL published on the card |
| `provider` · `model` | — | Model route for every agent this server creates |
| `card.public` | `true` | Serve the card without a credential |
| `card.skills` | `[]` | Declared skills; falls back to one `general` entry |
| `card.extendedSkills` | `[]` | Skills revealed only through `GetExtendedAgentCard` |
| `peers` | `{}` | Identity → credential **reference name** |
| `trustedPeers` | all authenticated | Access allow-list for conversation and scoped file reads; `[]` denies everyone |
| `rateLimitPerMinute` | `60` | Sliding window per identity |
| `maxContextTurns` | `5` | Messages accepted per context before `rejected` |
| `sendMode` | `block` | Default when the client sends no `returnImmediately` |
| `blockTimeoutMs` | `60000` | Maximum blocking wait; returns the current task on timeout so the client can poll |
| `contextIdleTtlMs` | `1800000` | Idle time before a context's agent is released |
| `maxResidentContexts` | `64` | Ceiling on resident contexts |
| `maxConcurrentTasks` / `maxConcurrentTasksPerPeer` | `8` / `

Configuration is refused at load when `isolation.workspaceRoot` is absent, a peer
name is not `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*`, a `tokenEnv` is not a POSIX identifier,
`trustedPeers` or `peerWorkspaces` names an undeclared peer, or `basePath` does
not start with `/`.

Configuration carries credential **references**, never values:

```yaml
peers:
  alice: { tokenEnv: A2A_PEER_ALICE }
```

```yaml

refs:
  A2A_PEER_ALICE: <32-byte-hex-from-openssl-rand>
```

`ctx.credentials` resolves the reference per request across four layers — the
process environment, the managed document, `<cwd>/.env`, and `$DSH_HOME/.env` —
so rotating a token takes effect on the next request without a restart. Peer
identity comes from the presented credential only; nothing in a request body can
assert it. There is no shared bearer token: isolation is built on distinct
identities.

| Layer | Guarantee | Mechanism |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Model context | One peer's conversation cannot enter another's model request | Separate `contextId` → separate Session → separate log |
| Protocol access | A peer cannot read, continue, or cancel another's context or task | Ownership by authenticated identity |
| Tooling | Only the scoped `read_file` is available; no writes, shell, network or cross-session tools | Inherited-tool masking, scoped reader, and execution guard |
| Prompt context | Public agents have a dedicated system prompt and suppress optional host runtime context | Scoped complete prompt and context suppression |

Visitor working directories now live outside `workspaceRoot`. The selected root
contains public data; `read_file` defaults to it and accepts `root: "workspace"`
for the current visitor's files. Portal automatically prepares Microsandbox:
one VM per visitor, read-only public projections and persistent private disks.
Idle VMs pause after 30 seconds and stop after 10 minutes, retaining files.
Backend conversation storage is not mounted. See [setup and limits](docs/visitor-isolation.en.md).

`read_file({"path":"."})` lists the root's entries. A file path reads UTF-8 text;
`offset` (1-based) and `limit` page lines or directory entries. Reads are bounded
to 2 MiB files, 32,000 returned characters and 500 lines/entries per call; directory
scans cover at most 1,000 entries. Binary/office-document extraction is not yet
implemented. Canonical path checks refuse escapes; symlinks, junctions, hard
links and Windows alternate data streams are rejected. No shell is invoked.
`preamble.files` continues to provide an optional opening briefing.

Owner RPC uses the same `/a2a` path on **local IPC**, authenticated with the admin
token. It retains the standard caretaker preset. The public HTTP listener accepts
only visitor credentials and never mounts the monitoring API. See the
[migration and deployment notes](https://github.com/huangjuhua-aigc/dsh-a2a/blob/main/docs/public-access-hardening.en.md).

- Inbound only. No outbound client, peer directory, or A2A subagent provider.
- JSONRPC binding only. gRPC and HTTP+JSON are not served, and the card says so.
- Push notifications are not implemented. `push.enabled` selects which error the
  push methods return; the card advertises `pushNotifications: false`.
- No `stateTransitionHistory`, protocol extensions, or card signatures.
- Streaming emits committed assistant messages. Per-chunk streaming is not
  implemented.
- Execution deadlines cancel the agent. Admission remains occupied until the
  underlying adapter finishes cancellation; an adapter ignoring AbortSignal
  needs process-level supervision. These limits are not a currency budget.
- Only rooted `read_file` is enabled for visitors. Other tools require separate
  capability work; changing the sandbox mode does not grant those tools. This
  application-level file reader is not an OS sandbox against a malicious local
  administrator mutating the filesystem.
- A token ceiling settles a task as `completed`; the real turn ending travels in
  `Task.metadata.dsh.stopReason`, which A2A's state enum cannot express.
- Task results and idle conversation history survive eviction/resta

```
src/
├── protocol/          dependency-free library: no Cordis, no HTTP, no harness
│   ├── wire.ts        the A2A v1.0 vocabulary: one shape, no translation
│   ├── parse.ts       inbound parsing and the method table

**A task is an interval, not a turn.** One submitted message may span several
turns if tools queue more work, so settlement uses three hooks:
`agent/inbox/claimed` binds the message to a turn, `turn/end` records that turn's
ending, and `agent.whenIdle()` settles once the whole agent is quiet.

**Task state lives in the session log.** Lifecycle transitions are `a2a/task`
events; a projection unit folds them into the read model. The terminal edge
carries the committed output, so the fold serves the answer without reaching
back into message history.

**Residency is explicit.** HTTP has no connection lifetime, so each `contextId`
maps to an Activation evicted when idle. Private checkpoints retain task results
and conversation history; cold restoration creates a new harness session.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test       # protocol, lifecycle, security and workspace-read regressions
pnpm serve      # a listening server

The end-to-end suites boot a real Cordis composition with a real agent loop and
drive it over HTTP, using a deterministic stub adapter so assertions do not
depend on model output.

Built against [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

The official project supplies the agent runtime, the plugin system, and the
capability seams this plugin consumes. This project supplies:

- The A2A v1.0 JSON-RPC binding, served inbound
- Agent Card construction and inbound request parsing
- Mapping between A2A tasks and harness turns
- Per-peer authentication, isolation, and workspace policy

The harness is pre-release and does not promise compatibility across renames or
repackaging, so compatibility is declared through `engines.dsh`
(`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`) plus range-bounded `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer
dependencies: an install preflight refuses any combination the plugin was not
built against, and the range admits every 0.2.x patch that follows.

Scan to join the WeChat group **A2A 产品应用和探索** — discussion of A2A in practice, this plugin included.

If the code has expired, open an issue and we will refresh it.
MIT

Talk2MyAgent Portal now supports automatic relay registration, a background Connector, publication controls and visitor invitations. This plugin continues to provide the local A2A service with its existing workspace and briefing rules. Relay is deployed independently. See [implementation and tests](docs/a2a-relay-implementation.zh-CN.md) and [Portal English guide](https://github.com/huangjuhua-aigc/Talk2MyAgent/blob/main/docs/relay.en.md).

`tests/relay.integration.spec.ts` is skipped unless **both** variables point at local checkouts:

- `A2A_RELAY_SOURCE` — the [a2a-relay-server](https://github.com/huangjuhua-aigc/a2a-relay-server) repository root
- `A2A_CONNECTOR_SOURCE` — Talk2MyAgent's `packages/a2a-connector` directory (run `pnpm install` in Talk2MyAgent first)

```sh
A2A_RELAY_SOURCE=/path/to/a2a-relay-server \
A2A_CONNECTOR_SOURCE=/path/to/Talk2MyAgent/packages/a2a-connector \
pnpm vitest run tests/relay.integration.spec.ts
```

It uses a stub model, temporary data and dynamic ports; no API key or DSH install is needed.

For public access, quota and visitor isolation scenarios, including an opt-in real-model local Relay walkthrough and MP4 recording scripts, see the [test matrix and reproduction guide (Chinese)](docs/test-cases-public-visitors.md).

dsh-a2a-server

为 DeepSeek Harness 提供入站 A2A 协议服务。
发布 Agent Card，接收任何合规 peer 提交的任务。
万物皆「插件」，它就是其中之一。

English · 简体中文

社区维护的插件，并非 DeepSeek 官方产品。

`dsh-a2a-server` 让 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
上的 agent 可以通过 [A2A（Agent2Agent）](https://a2a-protocol.org)协议被访问。它在
well-known 路径发布 Agent Card，并实现 **v1.0 JSON-RPC 绑定**——任何知道本部署
URL 的合规 peer 都能发现这个 agent 并向它提交任务。

本插件**只做入站**：从不主动连接其他 agent，没有 client、没有 peer 目录、没有 A2A
subagent provider。它是 `ctx.agents` 之上的传输适配层，不是能力接缝。

配套 Portal 可开启默认关闭的「允许公开访客」。统一使用 add/send 直接聊天；首次无 Token 时，技能只在收到明确的“消息未执行、需要匿名登录”指引后登记、保存服务端签发的凭据，再继续原消息。每个身份跨对话、重启累计最多 5 次，由本地服务端检查；用完提示联系 Agent 主人开通权限。这是可选 RPC 扩展，不是浏览器跳转，也不是所有 A2A 客户端自动支持的行为。详见[访客接入体验、额度与凭据保存](docs/public-visitors.md)。受邀访客保持原有权限；开启公开接入后，系统签发的公开身份不受静态 `trustedPeers` 名单限制。

需要本机配置界面或跨网络访问时，先看配套 [Talk2MyAgent 使用说明](https://github.com/huangjuhua-aigc/Talk2MyAgent)。
访客读取权限、自动简报、主人 IPC 与 Tailscale 部署详见[部署与迁移指南](https://github.com/huangjuhua-aigc/dsh-a2a/blob/main/docs/public-access-hardening.md)。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-a2a-server@0.4.1
```

`dsh plugin` 会在 profile 目录里转发给 pnpm，并把这个 bundle 追加进
`dsh.profile.bundles`——因为包中声明了 `dsh.bundle`。自 DSH v0.2.1-alpha.1 起，
`--profile` 必须放在所有 pnpm 参数之前——上面的写法已经是正确的。

若想直接使用本地检出，把路径指过去即可：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./path/to/dsh-a2a-server
```

| 依赖 | 由谁提供 |
| --- | --- |
| `ctx.agents` | `dsh-base` |
| `ctx.credentials` | `dsh-base` |
| `ctx.webServer` | **`dsh-web-app`** |
| `ctx.tools` 和 `ctx.systemPrompt` | 必需的访客工具及提示词隔离服务 |
| `ctx.sessionProjections`（可选） | 组合层；提供任务生命周期投影 |

必需服务齐备之前，插件保持 PENDING。`ctx.webServer` 由 `dsh-web-app` 提供而不在
`dsh-base` 中，因此 `headless` profile 需要先挂载 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver`。
`dsh --profile <name> --dump-config` 可以打印组合出来的配置行。

0.4.1 适配 DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`。先停止 agent，将
`dsh-a2a-server@0.4.1` 安装到原有 profile，再重新启动；配套 Portal 也需更新。
主人 RPC 和监控已改为需要认证的本机 IPC，公网 HTTP 不接受主人凭据。
访客可聊天并读取授权目录，其他工具关闭；空白名单 `trustedPeers: []` 拒绝所有访客。
任务结果与空闲会话在保留期内可跨驱逐和重启恢复。

新版 [Talk2MyAgent Portal](https://github.com/huangjuhua-aigc/Talk2MyAgent) 默认开启每小时简报更新，
用一个开关控制，完成后直接写入 `.hop/handoff.md`。单独安装协议插件而未配置 `briefing`
不会自动执行简报任务。

Portal 自动准备 Microsandbox，为每位访客提供独立沙箱。公共资料使用只读副本并排除 `node_modules`，私有文件保存在独立持久磁盘；空闲 30 秒暂停、10 分钟停止。独立 DSH 的旧配置保留原执行模式，安装插件本身不会自动启用 VM。详见[沙箱指南](docs/visitor-isolation.md)和 [0.4.1 发布说明](https://github.com/huangjuhua-aigc/dsh-a2a/blob/main/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md)。

仓库自带的示例组合会运行真实模型并启动一个监听服务。

```sh
pnpm install
A2A_PEERS="alice:demo123" A2A_PORT=9922 pnpm serve
```

```powershell
$env:A2A_PEERS = "alice:demo123"
$env:A2A_PORT = "9922"
pnpm serve
```

peer 名字是任意的——`alice` 只是这个 demo 的默认值，不是协议规定。可以声明任意多个，
token 既可以内联，也可以存在派生出来的凭据引用下：

```sh
A2A_PEERS="ops:tok1,research:tok2"   # 内联
A2A_PEERS="ops,research"             # token 取自 A2A_PEER_OPS / A2A_PEER_RESEARCH
```

模型凭据经 `ctx.credentials` 解析，因此 harness home、任一 `.env` 层或进程环境中已有的
`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 都会被直接采用。缺少凭据时启动失败。

获取 Card 并提交任务：

```sh
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9922/.well-known/agent-card.json

curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9922/a2a \
  -H "authorization: Bearer demo123" \

| 变量 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `A2A_PEERS` | `alice` | `名字[:token]` 列表；每个 peer 都必须有 token |
| `A2A_PORT` | `9900` | 监听端口 |
| `A2A_SEND_MODE` | `block` | `block` 或 `immediate` |
| `A2A_WORKSPACE_ROOT` | 临时目录 | 公共资料目录；访客工作区在此目录之外 |
| `DEEPSEEK_MODEL` | `deepseek-v4-flash` | 向适配器请求的模型 id |

一次性探针会对运行中的服务执行 67 项检查，任何一项不符即以非零码退出：

```sh
pnpm probe                                        # 默认 :9922 / demo123
node example/probe.mjs http://127.0.0.1:9922 demo123
```

| 路由 | 方法 | 认证 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/.well-known/agent-card.json` | GET | 默认公开 |
| `/.well-known/agent.json` | GET | 默认公开 |
| `{basePath}`（默认 `/a2a`） | POST | 必须携带 Bearer |
| `{basePath}/admin/contexts[/<id>]` | GET | 仅本机 IPC + admin token，公网 HTTP 不挂载 |
| `{basePath}/admin/prepare-stop` | POST | 仅本机 IPC + admin token；收尾任务、停止沙箱后确认可结束 DSH |

| JSON-RPC 方法 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| `SendMessage` | 是否等待逐请求协商 |
| `SendStreamingMessage` | SSE |
| `GetTask` | 幂等；结算后仍可应答 |
| `ListTasks` | 游标分页、可过滤；包括保留期内的持久化任务 |
| `CancelTask` | 取消正在执行的 turn |
| `SubscribeToTask` | 续订活任务；终态任务返回 `-32004` |
| `GetExtendedAgentCard` | 已认证 peer 可见的额外 skill；未配置时 `-32007` |
| `*TaskPushNotificationConfig` | `-32003` |

**只提供 A2A v1.0。** v0.3 的方法名、`kind` 判别字段、小写枚举、嵌套 `file`
part 是被**删除**而不是做了别名：本服务写出的每一个回包都是 v1.0 JSON，v0.3
客户端本就读不懂，所以“应答一个 v0.3 请求”只会让故障离成因更远。已退役的方法回
`-32601` 并直接告知新名字；显式的 `A2A-Version: 0.3` 回 `-32009`
（`VersionNotSupportedError`）。不带 `A2A-Version` 头的请求按 1.0 处理——这是本接口
在 Card 上声明的唯一版本。

具体到线上，与 v0.3 的差异：

| 关注点 | v0.3 | 本服务的 v1.0 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 任务引用 | `params.taskId` | `params.id` |
| `SendMessage` 结果 | 裸 `Task` | `{ "task": … }` |
| 任务状态 | `"working"` | `"TASK_STATE_WORKING"` |
| 消息角色 | `"user"` | `"ROLE_USER"` |
| Part | `{"kind":"text","text":…}` | `{"text":…}`；文件 part 展平为 `url`/`raw`/`filename`/`mediaType` |
| 流帧 | `{"kind":"status-update",…,"final":true}` | `{"statusUpdate":{…}}`；流关闭即终态信号 |
| 流首帧 | 一帧非终态 status update | `Task` 对象本身 |
| 等待控制 | `configuration.blocking` | `configuration.returnImmediately`（语义反转，默认等待） |
| Card 端点 | `url` + `preferredTransport` | `supportedInterfaces[]`，每条自带 `protocolVersion` |
| Card 鉴权 | `securitySchemes` + `security` | scheme 包在 `httpAuthSecurityScheme` 里；改用 `securityRequirements` |
| 扩展 Card | `supportsAuthenticatedExtendedCard` | `capabilities.extendedAgentCard` |
| A2A 错误细节 | 无 | `error.data[]` 携带 `google.rpc.ErrorInfo`，含 `reason` 与 `domain` |

入站消息可携带 text、file、data 三类 part。file 与 data 会以方括号引用的形式进入模型
上下文。回复为纯文本。

认证、限流与信任门分别以 HTTP `401`、`429`、`403` 应答，响应体仍是合法的 JSON-RPC 错误
信封。属于其他 peer 的任务，应答方式与不存在的任务完全一致。

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `basePath` | `/a2a` | JSON-RPC 路由 |
| `publicUrl` | 由 `Host` 推导 | 写入 Card 的可路由地址 |
| `provider` · `model` | — | 本服务创建的每个 agent 使用的模型路由 |
| `card.public` | `true` | 无需凭据即可获取 Card |
| `card.skills` | `[]` | 声明的 skills；为空时回退到一条 `general` |
| `card.extendedSkills` | `[]` | 只对已认证 peer 经 `GetExtendedAgentCard` 公开的 skills |
| `peers` | `{}` | 身份 → 凭据**引用名** |
| `trustedPeers` | 全部已认证身份 | 对话与受限文件读取白名单；`[]` 拒绝所有访客 |
| `rateLimitPerMinute` | `60` | 按身份的滑动窗口 |
| `maxContextTurns` | `5` | 单个 context 接受的消息数上限，超出后 `rejected` |
| `sendMode` | `block` | 客户端未表态时的默认行为 |
| `blockTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 最长阻塞等待；到期返回任务当前状态，客户端可继续查询 |
| `contextIdleTtlMs` | `1800000` | context 的 agent 被释放前的空闲时长 |
| `maxResidentContexts` | `64` | 常驻 context 数量上限 |
| `isolation.workspaceMode` | `per-peer` | 旧配置迁移字段；访客均使用外置私有 cwd |
| `isolation.workspaceRoot` | — | 必填；只放公共资料 |
| `isolation.peerWorkspaces` | `{}` | 旧版按访客覆盖读取根目录 |
| `isolation.privateRoot` | 用户主目录下按部署分隔 | 公共资料之外的私有工作区父目录 |
| `isolation.execution` | `read-only` | 设为 `microsandbox` 使用独立访客 VM（Portal 默认）；兼容 `docker` |
| `preamble.files` | `[".hop/handoff.md"]` | 主人背景简报文件（**agent 级**：相对工作区根目录解析，全体访客共用一份；绝对路径直通），合并进每个 context

以下情况在加载期即被拒绝：缺少 `isolation.workspaceRoot`；peer 名不匹配
`[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*`；`tokenEnv` 不是 POSIX 标识符；`trustedPeers` 或
`peerWorkspaces` 引用了未声明的 peer；`basePath` 不以 `/` 开头。

配置中携带的是凭据**引用名**，而非凭据值：

```yaml
peers:
  alice: { tokenEnv: A2A_PEER_ALICE }
```

```yaml

refs:
  A2A_PEER_ALICE: <32-byte-hex-from-openssl-rand>
```

`ctx.credentials` 在每次请求时跨四层解析该引用——进程环境、托管文档、`<cwd>/.env`、
`$DSH_HOME/.env`——因此轮换 token 在下一次请求即生效，无需重启。peer 身份只来自所出示
的凭据，请求体中的任何内容都无法声明身份。本插件不提供共享 bearer token：隔离建立在
互不相同的身份之上。

| 层 | 保证 | 机制 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 模型上下文 | 一个 peer 的对话不会进入另一个 peer 的模型请求 | 不同 `contextId` → 不同 Session → 不同 log |
| 协议访问 | peer 无法读取、续接或取消他人的 context 与任务 | 按认证身份判定归属 |
| 工具层 | 仅提供受控 `read_file`，不开放写入、命令、联网或跨会话工具 | 屏蔽继承工具、专用读取工具、执行校验 |
| 提示词 | 访客不继承可选的主人个性化提示与运行时上下文 | 独立的公共系统提示词 |

访客 cwd 现在放在 `workspaceRoot` 之外。所选目录只放公共资料，`read_file` 默认读取它，
传入 `root: "workspace"` 则读取自己的私有工作区。Portal 自动准备 Microsandbox，每位访客独立 VM，
公共资料副本只读、自己的持久化磁盘可写；空闲 30 秒暂停、10 分钟停止，文件保留，不挂后端聊天记录。
详见[安装、迁移与隔离边界](docs/visitor-isolation.md)。

`read_file({"path":"."})` 列出资料目录；文件支持 UTF-8 文本，按 `offset`/`limit`
分页。单文件上限 2 MiB，单次最多 32000 字符、500 行/项，目录扫描最多 1000 项。
拒绝越界、符号链接/junction、硬链接和 Windows ADS。主人维护能力使用独立本机 IPC，
保留可信管理工具，不能从公网入口调用。资源配额的完整配置表见英文 README。

- 只做入站。没有出站 client、peer 目录或 A2A subagent provider。
- 只提供 JSONRPC 绑定。不提供 gRPC 与 HTTP+JSON，Card 上如实声明。
- 未实现推送通知。`push.enabled` 仅决定推送方法返回哪个错误码，Card 上声明
  `pushNotifications: false`。
- 不支持 `stateTransitionHistory`、协议扩展与 Card 签名。
- 流式只推送已提交的 assistant 消息，未实现逐 chunk 推送。
- 有并发准入、任务期限及模型调用预算；超时后等待底层适配器完成取消才释放执行名额。
  不响应取消的适配器仍需进程级监管，这些额度不是按货币计费的预算。
- 访客仅能使用有目录边界的 `read_file`；改变沙箱模式不会自动开放其他工具。
  该工具边界不替代针对恶意本机管理员的操作系统隔离。
- 触及 token 上限的任务结算为 `completed`，真实的 turn 结束原因放在
  `Task.metadata.dsh.stopReason`——A2A 的状态枚举无法表达它。
- 任务结果与空闲会话在保留期内可跨进程重启恢复；中断的任务标记失败，不重放。
- 每个 context 同时只允许一个任务，并发提交返回 409；messageId 不是提交去重键。
- `ctx.webServer` 不提供 TLS。任何非回环地址的暴露都应置于反向代理之后。
- 修改配置会重启插件并取消进行中的任务。

```
src/
├── protocol/          零依赖库：不碰 Cordis、不碰 HTTP、不碰 harness
│   ├── wire.ts        A2A v1.0 词汇表：只有一种形状，不需要翻译
│   ├── parse.ts       入站解析与方法表

**task 是一个区间，不是一个 turn。** 一条提交进来的消息，如果工具排出了更多工作，可能
横跨好几个 turn，因此结算使用三个钩子：`agent/inbox/claimed` 把消息绑到某个 turn，
`turn/end` 记录该 turn 的结束原因，`agent.whenIdle()` 在整个 agent 安静后才结算。

**任务状态活在 session log 里。** 生命周期迁移是 `a2a/task` 事件，由 projection unit
折叠成读模型。终态那条边携带已提交的输出，因此折叠结果可以直接给出答案，无需回头翻消息
历史。

**驻留是显式管理的。** HTTP 没有连接生命周期，因此每个 `contextId` 对应一个 Activation，
空闲后被驱逐。私有 checkpoint 保留任务结果与对话历史，冷恢复时创建新的 harness session。

本项目基于 [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。

官方项目提供 agent 运行时、插件系统，以及本插件所消费的各个能力接缝。本项目提供：

- 入站的 A2A v1.0 JSON-RPC 绑定
- Agent Card 构造与入站请求解析
- A2A task 与 harness turn 之间的映射
- 按 peer 的认证、隔离与工作目录策略

harness 处于 pre-release 阶段，不承诺跨重命名或重新打包的兼容性，因此兼容性通过
`engines.dsh`（`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`）加上按 range 声明的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`
peer 依赖来表达：安装预检会拒绝任何插件未曾适配过的组合，而这个 range 也放行后续
所有的 0.2.x 补丁版本。
